atoms.a: Which of the following are not used in formal speech and writing?
Which things are often used in formal speech and writing?

atoms.b: The boss requested that you be present at the meeting.
I am excited to attend the party with you.
I can’t wait to see the Eiffel Tower!
Louisa is going to come to the cinema with us, right?
We’ve seen each other every day for the past ten years.

instruction.text: Find all the features that make the text an informal piece of writing.

atoms.b: ((Alex and Susanne’s wedding is next Saturday, right?)) ((Super exciting!)) They sent out the invites, and ((everyone’s)) replied to say they can come. The reception afterwards will be amazing. ((They’ve)) decorated in autumnal colours, and ((it looks incredible!)) The only downside is that after the wedding they will be on holiday for 3 weeks for their honeymoon, and ((I ain't gonna be able to see them)). Even so, ((I can’t wait for the big day!))

instruction.text: Write out the contractions in full to make the text more formal.

instruction.text: Replace the informal language to make the text more formal.

atoms.b: Is Alex and Susanne’s wedding next Saturday? It is very exciting.  They sent out the invites, and everyone has replied to say they can come. The reception afterwards will be amazing. They have decorated in autumnal colours, and it looks so beautiful. The only downside is that after the wedding they will be on holiday for 3 weeks for their honeymoon, and ((++I_will_not I_won’t)) be able to see them. Even so, I cannot wait for next Saturday.
